# jumpcloud_policy_template (Data Source)

Use this data source to read a JumpCloud policy template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jumpcloud_policy_template" "example" {
  id = "policy-template-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the policy template.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The description of the policy template.
- `name` (String) The name of the policy template.
- `os_family` (String) The OS family this template applies to (e.g. darwin, linux, windows).
